# Pantry — specification workspace (entry point)

The single map for any session opening this workspace with no memory of the interview.
Pantry is a single-user web app that turns a week of chosen meals into one shopping list.
**This is a map, not a manual — every rule and fact lives in the file it points to.**

## Working a task

1. Read [`AGENT.md`](06-agent/01-instructions/AGENT.md) — the rules and boundaries come first.
2. Take the next task from [`task-index.md`](02-tasks/01-planning/task-index.md) (start P0/P1).
3. Read its task file. Restate the task, list the files you will touch, name every assumption — and wait.
4. Write or adjust the tests first (see `03-tests/`).
5. Implement only the approved files.
6. Update [`traceability.md`](01-docs/08-traceability/traceability.md) and the change log.

## Never

- Add a feature that has no requirement — pause and ask instead.
- Change files outside the current task, or weaken or delete a test.
- Log or commit secrets, or serve a dish photo from a public URL.
- Use SQLite-only or Postgres-only SQL — keep it portable (ADR-002).
